methodology.scope: Native browser runs original app.ts and independent adapter side-by-side; exact complete JSON and retained string comparison
methodology.bridge: Vite pre-transform appends test-only bridge in memory; tracked app and offline artifact unchanged
methodology.fixture: Default synthetic app scenarios plus one qualified formal fixture through original file inputs and explicit adoption
methodology.not_proven: No production integration,4/8 capacity,complete browser-suite rerun,timing or peak-memory claim; unsupported JavaScript data can be rejected more strictly than legacy stringify
